methodology.availability: Available from canonical cohort spawn time until a confirmed debris break. Unavailable for exactly 180 seconds after each break, then available again regardless of later PVS CREATE timing.
methodology.breakSignal: k_EEntityMsg_BreakablePropSpawnDebris / paired LEAVE signal established in prior validation.
methodology.breakerAttribution: Only V1 canonical MELEE_DIRECT and BULLET_RAY attribution is treated as known breaker identity.
methodology.supplementaryAttribution: Exact-origin + exact-preDamage Script 40 candidates are retained but explicitly noncanonical and must not be used as known breaker identity in behavioral metrics.

supplementaryAttribution.reason: Observed 3/3 agreement and 0 conflicts in Script 40 controls, but the validation sample is too small for canonical promotion.
